rationale: naming had 4 distinct conventions (Cat-One, category_2, Category_N); normalized to Category_N to remove label drift and enable joins-by-name.
50 txn_ids were stored twice (47 identical + 3 conflicting). Kept the member with valid store/product and consistent line_amount per id.
qty in {1000..4000} appears only where line_amount is already qty*price; the true count is qty/1000 (evidence: amount invariant holds).
14 line_amounts were 100x the true qty*unit_price; line_amount is a derived field, so it is recomputed from the (trusted) qty & unit_price.
qty derived exactly from line_amount/unit_price (counts are integers).
unit_price derived exactly from line_amount/qty (no guess, full precision).
txn_date is a step-function of txn_id (contiguous daily blocks); forward-fill on the dense txn_id axis recovers the exact date.
store_id=9999 is a malformed key; the store cycle (1..5 per day, contiguous) identically determines the true store from the txn position.
product_id has no association with any observed column (uniform iid); reassigned by seeded sampling from P(product) to keep the marginal distribution unbiased and remain referentially valid.
re-express line_amount as the canonical qty*unit_price for full self-consistency (only the x100 rows change meaningfully).
